verdict.rationale: Sentry maintains official SDKs across many platforms (Python, Rust, Unity, Unreal, Godot and more), with step-by-step per-platform install guides. An AI-oriented installer also teaches coding agents to install and configure the SDK. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality and breadth, and evidence of official SDK clients for the management web API rather than just instrumentation SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Official Sentry SDKs ... Python ... Rust ... Unity ... Unreal Engine ... Godot Engine
Pick your platform below and follow our step-by-step guides to install the SDK and send your first event.
One command teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Grok how to install and configure Sentry for you.
